post.title: This $20 scratch-off pays back about $15 on average
post.ig:
This $20 scratch-off pays back about $15, on average.

Texas Lottery game #2764: about 25.7M tickets x $20 = $514M in sales, with $385M in prizes. That's 75% back.
Printed odds are 1 in 3.29, but 39% of wins just return your $20. Odds of winning more than $20: 1 in 5.43.
Minnesota's lottery (2023): $1 games pay about 63%, $50 games 74%.
In FY2025 the Texas Lottery sent $1.8B to the state, about 23 cents of each dollar.

Sources: Texas Lottery game #2764 prize table; Texas Lottery FY2025 release (Oct 2025); Minnesota Lottery (2023).
